pairs.subject: delivery-guarantees
pairs.evidence: app/_lib/ats-delivery-store.ts:88 The delivery ledger table schema declares an unstructured text column last_error for failure reasons rather than an authoritative typed reason token column and detail payload, causing deliberate skips and error reasons to be recorded as ungroupable prose.

techniques.evidence: app/_lib/ats-delivery-store.ts:183 Atomic CAS update claims pending delivery with a lease token and deadline, returning the token only on 1 affected row.
app/_lib/ats-egress.ts:318 Precondition does not hold because handler effects are external HTTP requests escaping local SQLite transactional boundaries.
app/_lib/ats-delivery-store.ts:84 Dead-letter rows retain only entry_id and event rather than the verbatim original payload, provide no human discard verb, and lack bulk triage verbs.
app/_lib/ats-egress.ts:281 Selects at-least-once with deduplication by transmitting stable delivery ledger id as Idempotency-Key and immutable sentAt across attempts.
app/_lib/ats-delivery-store.ts:303 Delivery status is updated to delivered only upon HTTP 2xx confirmation from the receiver, certifying acknowledged consumption.
app/_lib/ats-delivery-store.ts:319 Non-delivery and error reasons are written as arbitrary interpolated prose strings into last_error instead of groupable typed reason tokens.
app/_lib/ats-delivery-store.ts:309 Retries are bounded by MAX_ATTEMPTS with immediate escalation for terminal refusals and transition to dead-letter upon exhaustion.
app/_lib/ats-delivery-store.ts:209 Supervised lease sweep reclaims expired in-flight deliveries, increments the attempt count, and requeues or dead-letters accordingly.
